description:
Edit, annotate, convert and AI chat with PDF anytime, anywhere!

UPDF is a powerful PDF software that enables you to easily view, annotate, edit, convert, OCR, and organize PDF files. Its intuitive design allows users to perform tasks effortlessly, even without specialized skills. With advanced functionalities aimed at enhancing user experience, UPDF serves as an invaluable tool for business professionals, students, and anyone requiring PDF document manipulation. Integrated with AI technology, UPDF now offers even more robust capabilities, including summarization, translation, and explanation of PDFs.
- UPDF AI has been upgraded to Nomostar, offering AI assistants for academic work, contracts, finance, and other scenarios, with support for custom quick tasks.
- Ask questions about the entire document, the current page, or specific pages, start new chats, manage chat history, and resume previous conversations at any time.
- UPDF Sign is now integrated, allowing you to sign documents on the desktop, invite others to sign, and track signing progress.
- Translate and split PDFs in batches, and run multiple OCR and full-document translation tasks simultaneously.
- Customize the toolbar and how files open, and choose whether to remember your reading state and show gaps between pages.
- Find and mark text, and select pages to print directly in the thumbnails.
- More practical features and experience improvements are available in the new UPDF 3.0.
